name: Buildkite Integration
description: Runs CI on a self-hosted Buildkite agent (Apple silicon) instead of a metered cloud fleet. genproj creates the pipeline and registers its GitHub webhook — without the webhook, pushes trigger nothing — so there is no manual "set up project" step. Can run alongside CircleCI, so a repository can migrate without a flag day.

queue.description: Buildkite agent queue the generated pipeline targets.

provisionPipeline.description: Create the pipeline and register its GitHub webhook during generation. Set to false to only emit the .buildkite/ config.

benefits: Runs on your own hardware — no per-minute metering
No manual setup: the pipeline and its push webhook are provisioned for you
Installs dependencies once per build rather than once per step

actions.description: The pipeline is created in the Buildkite organisation during generation
Registers the pipeline GitHub webhook and triggers the first build. Without the webhook, pushes trigger nothing

notInV1: Deployment-aware steps: deploy jobs are contributed by the deployment capabilities (cloudflare-wrangler, docker-container), as they are for CircleCI — the Buildkite template does not yet honour them
Secret scanning (ggshield needs an API key the project may not have)
Path filtering (parity: the generated CircleCI config does not path-filter either)
